text:
Evan Park: Hi all  first day! Quick help request: I accepted the org invite but cant open the "UX Starter Kit" Figma file (shows Request access). Also where do we keep the product roadmaps and the research consent + payments process?

Tara Nguyen: welcome Evan!! :tada: I just provisioned you to the Designers group. UX Starter Kit is in the org-level library; sometimes Figma ties to a personal account. Try signing out and back in with SSO. If it still fails I can add you by email.

DesignOpsBot: Evan Park added to groups: Designers, Prototypes, UX-Libraries.

Evan Park: Still seeing Request access after SSO login.

Ravi Singh: Hey Evan  Im your PM. Roadmaps and PRDs live in Notion under /product/planning. Ill add you to the space; share if your SSO email differs. For an overview, check: https://notion.redwood.com/product/planning (SSO required).

Tara Nguyen: Quick troubleshooting steps that solve most of these:
1) Completely sign out of Figma and close browser tabs
2) Sign in through Okta/SSO (not Google)
3) Open the invite link in a fresh window or private tab
If a conflict with a personal account remains, paste the screenshot here and Ill force-add you to the file.

Sam (research-ops): Research ops here. Consent templates + participant payment flow live in Notion > Research Ops. We use Stripe Connect for payouts and SendCards for gift vouchers. Submit a payment request on the Research Ops page before running tests.

Evan Park: Screenshot attached showing Request access.

Tara Nguyen: Got it  force-added you to UX Starter Kit and to the "UX Prototypes" file. Can you confirm you can open it now?

Evan Park: Yup, I can open it now. Thanks! A couple more Qs: is there a designer first-week checklist and wheres the dev handoff template?

Tara Nguyen: Yes  Notion > Team Home > Onboarding has a "Designer 30-60-90" checklist and a condensed first-week list (set up dev tools, review design system, pair with engineer). The dev handoff template is a markdown file in the Design repo and a Figma handoff frame called "Handoff Checklist" inside the UX Starter Kit.

Ravi Singh: For handoffs we link the PRD under the Design Assets section and tag the eng lead. Also note we recommend enabling Figma dev-mode and adding exportable slices named with the component path.

Sam (research-ops): If you want to shadow sessions, we have a weekly "Research Observers" slot on Wednesday 11am. Ill add you to Lookback and the research calendar. Also, for any recordings you upload, tag them with the study ID (format: study-YYYYMMDD) and add the "research-eval" tag.

Evan Park: Wed 11am works for shadowing. Also, can someone point me to the token/component naming conventions? Im setting up prototypes.

Tara Nguyen: Token/convention docs are in the UX Starter Kit under the "Tokens & Naming" page and in the repo: https://github.com/redwood/ux-design-guidelines. If you need write access to tokens, DM me and Ill add you to the Design-System-Editors group.

DesignOpsBot: Evan Park added to Lookback and Research Observers calendar.

Evan Park: Awesome, thanks for the quick help everyone. One last small ask  who do I ping for a loaner laptop for design work?

Ravi Singh: Ping #people-ops for hardware checkout, or use the Hardware form in Notion. For prototyping we usually issue MacBook Pros with an M1 or M2 for short-term loans.

Tara Nguyen: Welcome aboard Evan  excited to pair on your first feature review next week!
